scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.dev:local: sh -c 'set -a && . .env.local && set +a && DATABASE_DRIVER=standard DATABASE_URL=$DATABASE_URL_LOCAL next dev'
scripts.db:push:local: sh -c 'set -a && . .env.local && set +a && DATABASE_DRIVER=standard DATABASE_URL=$DATABASE_URL_LOCAL prisma db push'
scripts.db:seed:trending-watchlist: echo 'Target required: pnpm db:seed:trending-watchlist:local OR :prod' && exit 1
scripts.db:seed:trending-watchlist:local: sh -c 'set -a && . .env.local && set +a && DATABASE_DRIVER=standard DATABASE_URL=$DATABASE_URL_LOCAL tsx scripts/db/seed-trending-watchlist.ts "$@"' _
